newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan's CPC sells November diesel at $29.92/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's CPC sells November diesel at $29.92/bbl.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has sold to German trader Stinnes a November diesel cargo at $29.92 per barrel on a free-on-board (fob) basis, industry sources said on Thursday.
Industry sources said CPC awarded another cargo to a separate trader at similar levels but the details were not immediately available.
A CPC official said the awards had not been confirmed yet.
Stinnes's 225,000-250,000 barrels cargo of 0.3 percent sulphur grade diesel is for lifting November 11-30 at Kaohsiung, sources said.
In its last tender, CPC sold two diesel cargoes to a Singapore trader and a Swiss trader at just under $27 per tonne for October 1-23 lifting fob Kaohsiung.
